# Gramlot examples 0.2.6

## Changes

Documentation only; the pages, the gallery and `build_gallery` / `buildGallery` are
unchanged.

- GE-010 §025 names the gallery commands that serve the examples:
  `gramlot <environment> gallery` (`gramlot-py-server`), `gramlot node|bun gallery`
  (`@gramlot/gramlot-js-server`) and `gramlot-serverless gallery <folder>`
  (`@gramlot/gramlot-serverless`). The development runner remains only in the history
  of this repository.
- GE-010 §030 cites amendment 11.56 of the Gramlot constitution, which supersedes 11.44.
- GE-010 §035 no longer describes the companions served by older adapter releases.
- GE-010 §040 no longer ties the package version to the core version; the core
  requirement is the dependency floor.
- The READMEs of e10 and e13 and the e13 catalogue entry name the static gallery of
  `gramlot-serverless gallery <folder>` instead of the standalone directory.
- The pages README separates the files of a page from the files the gallery adds.
- The README of c07 says that `js_requires` needs a Host with a resource system.
- The links of the package README are absolute, so they work on PyPI and npm.

## Requirements

Unchanged: Python 3.11 or later with `gramlot` 0.2.5 or later; Node.js 22 or later, or
Bun, with `@gramlot/gramlot` 0.2.5 or later.
